Environment Connection Instructions

Connect securely to your isolated container runtime via SSH or export the Docker socket variable in your terminal.

1. Terminal SSH Command:
ssh username@{{ serverHost }} -p 22
2. Docker Socket Environment:
export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/docker.sock"
